subject: Intro: Stratus Retail / Redwood demo & SI involvement

From: Nico Alvarez <nico.alvarez@vectoris-consulting.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Referral: Stratus Retail (Amit) interested in an intro/demo

Hi Rachel and Priyom,

Quick intro — Amit Shah at Stratus Retail (cc'd) is evaluating inference platforms to power an AI-powered search & personalization pilot. We ran a short scoping call and think Redwood's Dedicated + SI delivery model is a good fit. Amit already completed a self-serve signup and poked around the hosted API. He asked us to help coordinate a short technical demo with an emphasis on integration points for Vectoris.

Amit, Rachel is our SDR on this region and will get a demo on calendar. Priyom, looping you for partner handoff notes (Vectoris will take lead on implementation).

Attaching a one-pager and our internal referral note.

Thanks,
Nico
Vectoris Consulting
--

Date: 2026-11-28T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Referral: Stratus Retail (Amit) interested in an intro/demo

Hi Amit — great to meet you over email, and thanks Nico for the intro. I saw you already created a Redwood account — nice! We usually run a 30-minute technical walkthrough (live run, integration touchpoints, and Q&A) and include the SI up front. Marcus (AE) will join to cover architecture and next steps.

Quick availability from our side next week:
- Tue 12/1: 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 12/2: 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 12/3: 09:30–10:00 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple of windows that do and we'll adapt. Also, any specific systems you want us to prepare for (e.g., on-prem data connectors, KMS integration)?

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0127

--
Attachment: initial-demo-ics.invite (calendar stub)

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@stratusretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nico Alvarez <nico.alvarez@vectoris-consulting.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Referral: Stratus Retail (Amit) interested in an intro/demo

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the quick reply. Any of those windows look doable; Wed 12/2 at 14:00 PT is my first choice. Note: I already signed up and ran a quick sample with the hosted API (very impressed with latency). For the demo please include:
- How tagging / custom embeddings would work with our product catalog (we're on Snowflake)
- Private deployment options and KMS support (we handle PII in some flows)
- Rough cost/throughput guidance for a 50k-100k item catalog and 5k qps during peak windows

Also loop in the SI (Nico) so we can understand implementation timelines.

See you Wednesday.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of Engineering, Stratus Retail
amit.shah@stratusretail.com
